name: Zomato
tagline: India's #1 food delivery app, flagship of listed Eternal Ltd
facts: 2008 as Foodiebay, Deepinder Goyal and Pankaj Chaddah
Eternal Ltd (renamed from Zomato Ltd, 2025); NSE/BSE
Q1 FY27 NOV ₹10,769 cr (+20%), 5.6% adj EBITDA
~57% of food delivery GOV vs Swiggy ~43%
Eternal CEO Albinder Dhindsa; Food CEO Aditya Mangla

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Better food for more people: make food delivery cheaper, faster and more reliable across India.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Eternal as a multi-business consumer platform: Zomato (food), Blinkit (quick commerce), District (going out), Hyperpure (B2B supplies).

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Profitable growth: ~20% NOV growth with rising margins, funded by platform fees, ads and Gold, recycled into targeted discounts.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Largest restaurant selection and densest delivery fleet create liquidity; ad-tech and data let it monetise restaurants beyond commission.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: Bistro 10-minute kitchens and selective discounting to counter low-commission rivals like Rapido's Ownly and Swiggy's Toing without margin war.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Is food delivery now a cash cow funding Blinkit, and does that leave Zomato exposed to zero-commission disruptors?

customers.pain: Rising fees, inconsistent ETAs, cold food, opaque surge charges
customers.why: Widest selection, reliable delivery, Gold free-delivery perks, trusted ratings and reviews

customers.pain: Menu markups plus platform, delivery and packaging fees make orders expensive
customers.why: Targeted discounts, deals and broad restaurant coverage beyond metros

customers.who: 328K partners, cloud kitchens to QSR chains
customers.pain: 18-28% effective commissions, forced discounts, ad spend pressure, deductions
customers.why: Access to India's largest demand pool; ads and analytics drive incremental orders

customers.pain: Volatile per-order pay, heat and rain risk, limited social security
customers.why: Flexible hours, high order density, insurance and instant payouts

customers.who: Restaurants and F&B brands buying visibility
customers.pain: Hard to prove ROI on sponsored listings
customers.why: Intent-rich placements at moment of ordering, measurable order lift

products.name: Zomato app
products.desc: Restaurant discovery and on-demand food delivery across hundreds of Indian cities

products.name: Zomato Gold
products.desc: Paid membership: free delivery and discounts above order thresholds

products.name: Bistro
products.desc: 10-minute food from own kitchens, standalone app

products.name: Zomato for Enterprise
products.desc: Corporate meal allowances and office food ordering

products.name: Zomato Ads
products.desc: Sponsored listings and banners sold to restaurants

portfolio.north_star: Weekly delivered orders arriving on time and as ordered
portfolio.key_metrics: NOV, MTC, order frequency, AOV, adj EBITDA % NOV, Gold penetration
portfolio.guardrails: Restaurant churn, delivery partner earnings/hour, complaint rate, cancellation rate

products.name: Restaurant Partner app
products.desc: Menu, orders, payouts, promotions and ratings management

products.name: Hyperpure
products.desc: B2B ingredient and kitchen supplies for restaurants (Eternal)

products.name: Delivery Partner app
products.desc: Rider onboarding, order allocation, earnings and insurance

portfolio.north_star: Active restaurants growing profitable online sales on Zomato
portfolio.key_metrics: Active restaurants, ad revenue per restaurant, payout accuracy, rider utilisation
portfolio.guardrails: Commission disputes, forced-discount complaints, rider attrition

products.name: Blinkit
products.desc: Quick commerce; now Eternal's largest revenue line

products.name: District
products.desc: Going-out: dining reservations, movies, events tickets

portfolio.north_star: Cross-app customers transacting across two or more Eternal services
portfolio.key_metrics: Cross-sell rate, shared rider fleet utilisation, group adj EBITDA
portfolio.guardrails: Food delivery margin not diluted to fund Blinkit

rows.how: Percentage of order value, typically ~18-25% plus payment gateway fees
Platform fee ₹14.90/order, delivery fees, ₹5-20 cash-on-delivery fee
Cost-per-click sponsored listings and banner placements
Paid membership fee for free delivery and discounts

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Food delivery revenue ~₹3,100 cr/quarter; commissions dominate, with ads and platform fees the fastest-growing high-margin lines.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: Customers pay food plus fees; restaurants pay commission and ads; riders paid per order from both pools.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Adj EBITDA 5.6% of NOV in Q1 FY27; ~₹600 cr quarterly profit, among world's most profitable food delivery businesses.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Tier-2 penetration, cheaper Bistro/value formats, Gold frequency, ad yield, enterprise ordering, faster delivery.

bullets.label: Reporting shift
bullets.text: From Q1 FY27 Eternal reports Net Order Value (after discounts) instead of GOV, complicating Swiggy comparisons.

friction: Stacked platform, delivery and COD fees feel hidden
Menu prices higher than restaurant dine-in prices
ETA promises missed during rain and peaks
Refund and missing-item disputes are slow
Restaurants resent forced discounts and deductions

competitors.label: Duopoly rival
competitors.text: Swiggy Food (~43% share), Swiggy Toing budget delivery

competitors.label: Disruptors
competitors.text: Rapido Ownly zero-commission, Swish 10-min food, Flipkart food pilot, ONDC

competitors.label: Restaurant direct
competitors.text: Domino's, McDonald's own apps; Thrive and WhatsApp ordering

competitors.label: Quick food
competitors.text: Swiggy Bolt, Zepto Cafe, Blinkit-adjacent snacking

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Scale, ~5.6% margins, ad engine, Eternal cash to outlast price wars

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Commission backlash, gig-worker rules, GST on delivery, zero-commission entrants

news.label: Oct 2026
news.text: GST Council proposes 5% GST on e-commerce delivery services, no input tax credit.

news.label: Sep 2026
news.text: Introduced ₹5-20 cash-on-delivery fee; Aug cut 250 support roles, shut Hyderabad centre.

news.label: Aug 2026
news.text: Bengaluru restaurants' boycott deferred after Zomato agreed opt-in, OTP-approved discount campaigns.

news.label: Watch
news.text: Can Zomato keep ~20% growth and margins as Ownly, Toing, Flipkart chase price-sensitive users?

sources: Eternal Q1 FY27 and FY26 results, earnings call coverage (MediaNama, Kotak Neo), press reports 2025-26. Metrics are PM estimates for interview prep. Prepared Oct 2026.
